# v1.20.2 — Standalone PlainSeer repository

AlphaESS Modbus TCP is now maintained in the independent
[PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp)
repository. The complete branch/tag history and published releases were copied
from the previous PlainSeer fork. Original credits and the MIT licence remain.

Repository links, support/documentation links, HACS instructions, badges and
preview URLs now point to the new repository. The Main, Readings and Diagnostics
layout and its previews are unchanged. The PlainSeer chip in HACS remains an
author-profile link, as defined by HACS.

For existing installations, follow the
[HACS migration guide](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/blob/v1.20.2/docs/hacs-migration.md).
Keep the configured Home Assistant integration and replace only its HACS download
source. The domain, entity identifiers, configuration and dashboard ownership
records are unchanged. No inverter-control or polling behaviour changes.

The previous repository remains available for rollback. GitHub's stars and
download counters start independently in this repository. Historical release
descriptions include their original source and publication date.

Validation covers the supported HA versions, frontend tests, HACS/hassfest,
complete package contents and an offline HACS file-lifecycle migration check.
The public ZIP and all preview links are verified after publication. Creating
this repository does not install it into an existing Home Assistant instance.
